notes.title: Patch Note 2.4 – MagiCats Builder Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30491238/efdd621e8645613054cae37b6cd213c296d8a773.png[/img]

[h1]Hello everyone![/h1] 

After the last update, we saw an [b]incredible increase in the variety of levels[/b] you made! Adding the weapon switching mechanic gave a lot of freedom to content makers, and we’re tremendously happy about this. That’s why we have added another major feature in this update as well, and this feature is just as incredible, if not more! Keep reading to get all the info about it!

We also added a [b]number of needed fixes[/b] brought from the last update, as well as a few [b]MAJOR features[/b] you’ve been asking for the game. We’re always watching out for good ideas from you guys, so don’t hesitate to give us your thoughts, this is how we strive to make [b]MagiCats Builder[/b] better!

[b]Here are the full Patch Notes:[/b] [i]https://magicatsgame.com/2018/10/04/patch-note-2-4-magicats-builder-update/[/i]

As another reminder, we have been reviving the [b]Fair Game[/b] concept in Dreamz, which allows creators to get paid while having fun creating content! Don’t hesitate to check it out here, and watch out for any future projects from the studio 😉

For more info: [i]https://magicatsgame.com/fairgame/[/i]

notes.title: Patch Note 2.3 – MagiCats Builder Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30491238/6441b8a6c6bbbdf72b8e413876f8cc7b50d6fcfc.png[/img]

FULL PATCH NOTES HERE (with demonstrative GIFs of new features): https://magicatsgame.com/2018/09/07/patch-note-2-3-magicats-builder-update/

[b]Hello everyone![/b]
 

[b]MagiCats Builder[/b] is going on and staying strong! As we promise, we work hard to make the game better than ever with every coming update, and this update is no exception! After weeks of sweat and tears, we are bringing you a new version of the game which we are deeply proud of and represents only a small part of what is coming in the future.

This time, we have added a few [b]major features and several needed fixes[/b] for your playing pleasure! As always, thank you for staying and helping this community grow stronger by the day! This whole adventure, this progress, it is done with your help, and we could never have gotten this far without the community’s support.

Since we’re talking about community support, most of you guys know about the concept we developed at Dreamz: the [b]Fair Game concept[/b]! It allows you to win money by using your innovation skills and your creativity, all the while playing MagiCats Builder. All you need to do, is create awesome levels!

For me info: https://magicatsgame.com/fairgame/

**Important notice: We’re still keeping an open ear for any feedback, and we’re constantly updating the game, adding gameplay possibilities and in-game objects. Now, let’s get into it!**

 

[h1]Artistic[/h1]

- Changed the end of level animation and replaced the classic environment house with the Castle stele

Even though a house was pretty fun, we felt that it lacked the epicness that our MagiCats deserved. Thus, we now have a magical pier to finish levels, with everything needed to finish your levels. Teleportation free of charge!

 

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]

- Added a Change Player Power bloc of code: [b]NEW MAJOR FEATURE![/b]

Biggest reveal of the update! Creators will now be able to change the power associated with the player’s weapon, and as you can see, these can get pretty interesting! A game changing feature, hopefully with game changing consequences! Use at your own risk, but be warned: it’s extremely fun to use…

- Added NPC Toggle for Enemies

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30491238/0be7f148305d5018de0e03025d75a9cb44ffe501.png[/img]

Remember that time when you had to give Protego to enemies that you wanted to make friendly? As of now, you can toggle the NPC status of your characters to make them friendly to the player! Assemble an army of friendly NPC, and mount the attack against the bad NPCs if you so desire…

- Character will no longer die when climbing down and hitting the camera border and will stop instead

Whoah! Let me hold you there! If you jump in the vast emptiness, you will still die. Just means that you won’t if you do it will climbing buddy. Geez, calm down…

- Added friction on objects not affected by gravity

We realized physics were a bit off with objects not affected by gravity. And while they weren’t affected by gravity, and that was already off physics-wise, we decided that not having friction was a bit too much. So friction’s there now!

- Added a SaveOnCheckpoint bloc of code

Roughly said, but you can now keep items as they were upon death and respawn on checkpoint.

- Added Crokeluns as new enemies

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30491238/9b9b0d52e00b88d66ca5cf1a779a46ed831bd577.png[/img]

We had many people urging us to add the famous Crokeluns from the Best Of to the Builder. Well, it’s done, and this is just a little taste of the total number of new enemies added! Your boss fights have now gotten a 1UP in quality 😉

- Added Disguised Marshmallow and Marshmallow as an enemy

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30491238/45829c9ff73ecc55e5aaf36828c47cbde3a59b18.png[/img]

Marshmallow in his Normal and Disguised forms have now been added to the roster of NPCs. Watch out for too much cuteness with all that evilness!

- Added the Cannon object

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30491238/64c1c4dd97b7481049d628d16c9d3838e8cde305.png[/img]

And also, we added a big cannon.

 

[h1]Design/Store/Social[/h1]

- Added in-game chat

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30491238/641d54e798b13030dfa111547005bc766ee368ff.jpg[/img]

Woooooaah! Social stuff! You wanted to talk to your buddy MagiCats? Now you can, with people from ALL around the MagiCats Worlds *wink wink*

- Menu navigation with a controller is now working as intended

- Navigation in the Shop when a daily quest is bought is now better
 


[h1]Multiplayer (Steam version)[/h1]

- Added Toggle PVP Code Block

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30491238/1bb8af46919454d3cf34718f7b5d766be699ecc9.png[/img]

You will now be able to trigger PvP using a dedicated bloc of code, along with a cute animation. For your PvP pleasures, your arenas and deathruns, we bring to you the official version of our PvP, polished out more than ever! Enjoy shooting fire balls at your friends!

- Camera is now smoother in PvP mode

[h1]Bug Fixing[/h1]

- Boss attack collision is now fixed

- Player shooting bolts while running is now fixed

We had an annoying bug where shooting and running caused the character to just not do anything. We fixed that, it was really bringing down the adrenaline from all those Rateur Sorcerer fights…

- Steam achievement “Judge” is now properly obtained
After Discord rained down on us for two straight weeks for this achievement being bugged, we unbugged it. There you go, you’re welcome Discord. Now go catch Pokemons again!

- Notifications now work as intended

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30491238/f7d4cadff64e071127c883b3d391d7a54c8f24d3.png[/img]

Remember the small notification which used to sometimes work and sometimes not work? Now it works.

Have you found a bug? Tell us about it on Discord here: https://discord.gg/7atKnwF !

 
And that’s it for this week! Don’t forget to tune in back soon, we have more updates coming in the following weeks for you, and game-changing features are planned for each of them 😉

Magically yours,

 

[i]The Dreamz Team[/i]

notes.title: Patch Note 2.2 - MagiCats Builder Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30491238/82dfa2fa312ff02dba12d8dc03f6e63a96e531f5.png[/img]

[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]
 

With the release of [b]MagiCats Builder[/b] almost one month ago, we’ve been listening to all your feedback (and I mean it, all your feedback), and we’ve given lots of stuff for our studio MagiCats to work on.

This [b]new update[/b] brings tons of [b]bug fixing[/b], and even some [b]new graphical features[/b] and [b]accessibility conveniences[/b] so you can play the game as smoothly as possible. Rest assured, new content is always being prepared by our MagiCat Picassos as we speak. Again, [b]thanks for sticking with us, we try to make this adventure better every day, and you’re a big part of what keeps us going[/b]!

**Important notice: We’re still keeping an open ear for any feedback, and we’re constantly updating the game, adding gameplay possibilities and in-game objects. Now, let’s get into it!**

 

[h1]Artistic[/h1]


- New skins have been added to the game
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30491238/c5a97a563f8750ce8eb5cffd104218c6f21b09a3.png[/img]

- New vines design

- Vines are now Chains in the Castle Environment

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30491238/d33c2dc5ab57830453b0429021fa62751709c933.png[/img]
“New vines! But vines are chains? Wait what?!” Don’t worry, it’s not as confusing as it looks… We thought the old vines looked cool, but we wanted them to be as cool as you, so we made them better! Since it’s kind of weird to have huge vines in castles, we made some extra big chains for the Castle environment!

 

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]


- Several fixes on the tutorial mode

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30491238/4cbf7a29dd8ae775e4faf4cf2fdb7b03c784c97d.png[/img]
We managed to notice a few bugs *ahem* by ourselves *cough cough* where some tutorial levels where a bit bugged out… Tutorials are important, they show you stuff! Since we don’t want you to not know stuff, we fixed that stuff! Enjoy some fun learning 😊

- Cut Adventure mode

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30491238/a44d470dbb5463b908ff9cc632f3037bb4552a1e.gif[/img]
Sad news of the day: we had to cut the Adventure mode. We made this difficult decision because we decided that it was better to focus our work on the Build mode and make it as polished and shiny as possible. Keeping a bugged Adventure mode that we could not work on would just diminish the overall quality of the game, and the quality of our game is something we hold dear to our hearts. We hope you’ll understand that choice.

- Wall-climbing transition is now fixed

- Added a new code bloc “Display Boss Health”

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30491238/378bdf9057bb0175e9787f1e15bf35975668f6f0.png[/img]
You can now create that super mega OP boss you wanted to do with a huge health-pool! Only now, people don’t have to guess how much HP he has left anymore…

- Added a new code bloc “Travel To”/”Camera Move”/”Camera Shake” to help you move the camera around
Ever fancied yourself a camera man? Ever dreamt of making a cinematographic experience in all that glorious 60FPS goodness? Your dreams have now come true!

- Added a new code bloc “Display Image” which comes with a new Frame Object

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30491238/892d2819752cf8c0600d9bb25ae3a267b2d5a0d5.png[/img]
You can now display any image you want in your level… More creative freedom, yay!

- Fixed animation transition bugs which stopped the players from grabbing onto nearby surfaces
As you can see, the player could sometimes grip onto some surface but would still fall. This has been fixed for multiple instances, so the controls should feel tighter and more responsive!

 

[h1]Design/Store/Social[/h1]


- Fixed some controller navigation on different menus (notably the main menu)
It was a bit weird having to move up your d-pad to move to an menu icon on the right of where you were, so we fixed that for ya!

 

[h1]Sound[/h1]


- Improved the transition between different music themes

- Remove SFX when the player is Idle

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30491238/a0bcf06aba7394f551e0fb907e653327142daf8e.png[/img]
Remember that annoying meow he does whenever he gets tired of waiting for you to actually do something? Well, it was annoying for us too, so… just like that, it’s gone!

 

[h1]Multiplayer (Steam version)[/h1]


- Fixed the camera when Multiplayer is activated

- Fixed the grip between characters (they can no longer climb on each other)
It was funny seeing MagiCats hanging all around on top of each other, but it was kind of messing multiplayer sometimes, so we fixed that too.

 

[h1]Bug Fixing[/h1]

- Fixed the Invoke Enemies command: the state is correctly reset even if the original object is hurt

- Fixed the achievement flow: it correctly now waits for the server response

- Fixed level tags: It is now possible to Edit a level after giving it a tag

Have you found a bug? Tell us about it on Discord here!


 

That’s all we’ve got for you today! As always, feel free to give us some feedback, we always love to hear from you!

Magically yours,

 

[i]The Dreamz Team[/i]

notes.title: Patch Note 2.0 – MagiCats Builder Launch
notes.notes:
[b] Hello everyone! [/b] 

We’ve been silent quite a while, but it’s been for a good reason! All this time, we’ve been working like crazy with all the MagiCats to make the kingdom even better. And now, we’re proud to present you the official release of MagiCats Builder! 

The game is now out of early access/beta and has become something far greater than what we first released, 8 months ago. We’re extremely proud of this and we hope you’ll like playing it as much as we had fun making it. So here it is: thank you for following us through this journey and we hope you will follow us for the rest of it as well. 

**Important notice: releasing MagiCats Builder does not mean we will stop updating it. We will continue to hear you guys, add gameplay possibilities and in-game objects. Now, let’s go to the patch note!**


[h1] ARTISTIC [/h1]

•	Remaster of the enemies and the classic environment

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30491238/f3d11e70280817db7ad4c56f9a9206a4817f5eff.jpg[/img]

They’re bigger and more mature! Enjoy also the remastered classical environment with redesigned decoration! 😉

•	New environment: Castle!

 [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30491238/31aa47f0470f1606c25e150cb015594a0a836593.jpg[/img]

Nothing feels better than blasting some Ratters in their own Castle! Explore the new Castle environment for some frightening adventures into the deepest corners of their dungeons… Have you got what it takes?

•	New variation of the classic environment

 [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30491238/b5901f52a6950124098b1994eb03e052d09bbf45.jpg[/img]

Tired of the sun? Feeling like you need a good midnight stroll or the cold touch of rain on your neck? These new variations are for you!

•	Updated animations for the player

•	Updated animations for the enemies

•	Revamped Mushroom and Door

•	Animation of the MagiCats Builder logo
 
With the game releasing today, the whole team has been jumping around and so is the logo now!
•	New fur skins

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30491238/18079da398ec38b556fe9a6d4ada524455231462.png[/img]
   
Now, you can customize your MagiCats more than ever before, with some new skins coming soon! We’ve even made a pink one for the cutest of you 😉

•	New Castle decorations

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30491238/7a32e47b3a249af9695bb7597ce1d46d422ccff3.jpg[/img] 

How scary can a Castle be when it’s empty? Don’t worry, we got you covered, and added some terrifying decorations to fill your Castle levels with! 

•	Revamp of multiple decoration assets

•	New main screen menu

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30491238/bbbdc30ff73361cea9be785bd85fd325365be859.png[/img]
 
We made an all new menu screen for you guys, and it’s even more dynamic. Now, you’ll know you’re truly in the MagiCats kingdom!

•	Updated user interface in multiple area


[h1] GAMEPLAY [/h1]

•	Added the « dash » jump

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30491238/aefdf1d6d1431a83f8da49f0f2622f90c37670ab.jpg[/img]
 
One of the most demanded feature is here… The MagiCats have been training all summer, and can now dash after jumping! Become the ultimate MagiCat parkour master!

•	Added the Generals in the pool of enemies (previously a Best Of exclusivity)

•	Added a charged projectile

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30491238/914956031d7fe051d082341f5d35755fe6da4db6.png[/img]
 
The MagiCats are now the great Wizards they were destined to be… Charged shots will let you rain fire on your enemies!

•	Added aimed projectiles
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30491238/8bd2fb81c1d525a6af2e609a0cf16a83627ead39.png[/img]

MagiCats aren’t just more powerful, they’re now even more accurate. They can now aim their shots where the cursor is pointed! You can be a true marksman now! (+)

[h1] DESIGN/STORE/SOCIAL [/h1]

•	New loading screen
You’ll be able to stare at a beautiful new artwork with bonus tips (don’t worry, tips are on the house 😉)
•	Steam trophies
Proud of all these cool things you’ve done in-game? You can now brag about it on your Steam profile.

•	Added the Infinite Pack

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30491238/ab537e71c9188aa88c26b321d080ee92a46dd399.jpg[/img]

Finally, it’s here, one of the most demanded features of the community: The Infinite Pack! 
Have you been dreaming about the ultimate MagiCats experience? Endless building? A completely epic look? The Infinite Pack is for you. Offering you EVERY item, skin, environment, boss, etc. in-game, you’ll be the most powerful MagiCat in the entire kingdom.


[h1] MULTIPLAYER (STEAM VERSION) [/h1]

•	Added a 2-4 players local multiplayer

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30491238/0e56925883b1ed72bbeba3882da901ce39630bc9.jpg[/img]

The MagiCats are now facing more dangers than ever and have decided to join forces. Play with up to 4 MagiCats on any level of the community!
 

[h1] BUG FIXING [/h1]

•	Gameplay/Tutorial/Design/etc. fixes
Have you found a bug? Tell us about it on Discord here: https://discord.gg/7wBPUr5

And that’s it for now! We’ve worked hard on this and we’re proud that you get to try it. Don’t hesitate to give us some feedback, we always love to hear from you!


[i] The Dreamz Team [/i]

notes.title: Win Free Movie Tickets with your friend together!
notes.notes:
Hello adventurer,

With the spring coming, it’s the perfect timing to hang out with your friend! We prepared [b]two movies tickets[/b] (Yes, you can choose the movie you like) for you to win in MagiCats’ world!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30491238/6def40b3d5ee854dec17a29e7b7337dc252c42f6.png[/img]

Here are the steps:

notes.title: Crazy Dreamz: MagiCats Edition – Patch 0.7 notes
notes.notes:
Welcome to the patch 0.7 notes, team!
Please note that you have to upgrade your version of Crazy Dreamz: MagiCats Edition on Steam to gain access to this content!

—–

[b] Features [/b]

• A brand-new game mode: daily quests! Achieve the three levels to receive an awesome reward!

• Crazy Dreamz has been traduced in three more languages: Chinese (simplified), Portuguese (Brazil) and Russian.

—–

[b] Big News [/b]

• We began a long-term partnership with Qwant, the search engine that respects your private life.
• Qwant watches on your privacy. We love what these guys are doing since they DON’T use cookies or user trackers.

• During December, you must try the five new missions designed for celebrating this partnership. Experience the power of search engines! Discover the first mission on the 1st of December.
• At the end of December, participate to the first Crazy Dreamz contest. To win, build the best level and submit it!

—–

[b] Graphical [/b]

• Main character’s jump and objects pushing’s animations have been redesigned:

• Look at those sparkles! (Honestly, we don’t understand either but our programmer was so proud, we need to integrate it.) New effect for coding block’s bond


—–

[b] Corrections [/b]

• More stability on the web version of Crazy Dreamz.
• Corrections to the coding blocks and the physical rules.
• And several other bugs were fixed, if you want to help us finding the last ones, you can join our discord by clicking this link.

notes.title: Crazy Dreamz: MagiCats Edition – Patch 0.6 notes

Hi friends,

Corrections 
-    Physics’ improvements
-    Controller’s improvements
-    Many bug were fixed!
-    Character’s improvements (abilities)
-    Many optimizations (RAM, Web version, menus)

Many more surprises are coming to Crazy Dreamz, stay tuned on Twitter and Facebook. You can also join our Discord community => https://discordapp.com/invite/36uNMPF
